title: First hearing Art Tatum; 'Tiger Rag' for Earl Hines in Chicago
summary: He recounts first meeting Art Tatum in Louisville, doubting him next to Lannie Scott, then hearing him play 'Tiger Rag' in a Chicago after-hours spot; on to Atlanta and Memphis.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Art Tatum: the legend, the piano and the man

blocks.x: I mean at one time she had Art and Joe at the same time, didn't she...
I think so. Joe got in...
When you first heard Art was he playing already in that same...
When I first heard Art I didn't think he could play as well as Lannie Scott. I first met Lannie in Shreveport. But I learned my lesson. Art Tatum is...well,

when I first heard him in Chicago, Earl Hines...well, I went to this after-hours spot and Lovey Taylor said to me, said to Earl Hines, "Earl, there's a kid in town playing the piano. Like to hear him?" Earl said, "No, I don't want to hear nobody." So Art Tatum started playing "Tiger Rag," you know...it was just amazing. You just couldn't believe that one man could play that fast, or do as much, or had as much...was ambidextrous or musically developed beyond, you know, the descriptions, he was just so amazing. And from then on Art and I became very, very close and there is one thing I cherish...a picture I have of Art Tatum and myself and Teddy Wilson. Now, the picture's all right, but do you know who's sitting at the piano? I'm sitting at the piano and Teddy and Art are looking down at me playing. So, it was, you know...he was really something to behold. But from Mobile we went to Atlanta. At Atlanta Graham Jackson was playing the organ in the 81 Theater. Eddie Heywood was in town and...

Senior. Eddie Heywood, Senior. Eddie Heywood, Junior was not around at that time. And from that we went to Memphis... I think we saw Lovey Taylor...was Lovey Taylor a woman piano player? Yeah, I think that was her name. But anyway, we'll check that, so, because I want to be certain there. But then I met W. C. Handy on the TOBA.
